entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker driven by restless impatience and a wild temper.

entities.name: The Sun Empire
entities.description: An empire whose coastal towns Angrath endlessly raids.

events.summary: Angrath's restless impatience spurs him on in an endless series of raids on the Sun Empire's coastal towns.
